item.title: Halcyon Symbios™ Chest Mount Rebreather Expands Availability to Divers Worldwide in Mid-March
item.description: Halcyon Dive Systems is pleased to announce that theSymbios™ Chest Mount Rebreather will expand global availability by mid-March, marking the next phase in its rollout to divers worldwide.

item.title: Polar ice diving: Shearwater blog answers the most common questions
item.description: In a post on their blog, dive-technology company Shearwater Research has shared a practical Q&A on polar ice diving, covering conditions, training expectations, and equipment considerations for extreme cold-water environments.

item.title: From “Performing Skills” to Owning Them: GUE Performance Diver Course
item.description: For divers who want control and confidence first—and a clear path toward more advanced training later. The GUE Performance Diver Course helps turn practiced skills into reliable, real-world performance.

item.title: Into Mexico’s Blackest Cave: Cenote Cocom
item.description: How tannins, flow, and geology shaped a cavern of pitch-black walls—and why Emőke Wagner says its future is suddenly uncertain.

item.title: By Jarrod Jablonski: Team Diving
item.description: Few topics stir as much debate in the diving world as solo diving. For some, it represents independence, freedom, and even mastery. For others, it is an unnecessary risk. My own views were shaped over decades—by mentors, by exploration projects, and sadly, by the loss of friends.

item.title: Elba Sidemount Festival 2026 Unites Technical Diving Culture, Training, and Community
item.description: Elba Sidemount Festival 2026 is a three-day sidemount and technical diving gathering, hosted by Elba Diving and the 4FreeWorldcommunity, April 24–26 in Marciana Marina—bringing divers focused on deliberate trim, thoughtful configuration, technical exchange, and continuous improvement.

item.title: Kewin Lorenzen Named Finalist in Explorers Club “Epics of Exploration” Photo Contest
item.description: Cave explorer and underwater photographer Kewin Lorenzen has been selected as a finalist in The Explorers Club “Epics of Exploration” Photo Contest for a panoramic image captured deep inside Lucy’s Cave on Sweeting’s Cay, on the remote eastern edge of Grand Bahama Island.

item.title: FATHOM Expeditions Announces Malta 2026
item.description: Purpose-built for experienced technical divers, this 11-night Malta program delivers eight full wreck-diving days spanning 40–115m with both normoxic and hypoxic options, backed by included O₂/diluent/sorb and dedicated bailout cylinders to simplify logistics; the mid-week Valletta history day is a smart reset that adds real context to Malta’s wartime wreck heritage.

item.title: James Mott Launches the “Instructor Evolution Assessment” for Scuba Instructors
item.description: In a training industry where many instructors don’t burn out but quietly plateau, educator and founder James Mott (Mott Underwater) has introduced the Instructor Evolution Assessment—a free professional self-evaluation designed to help current and aspiring scuba instructors pinpoint where they are in their development and where they can grow.

item.title: Why the 2026 Human Factors in Diving Conference Belongs on Your Calendar
item.description: Most diving conferences focus on equipment, techniques, and destinations. However, from May 31 to June 5, 2026, on the island of Vis, Croatia, The Human Factors in Diving Conference will do something different. We will focus on the diver and how they interact with other divers—with their technology, with the environment, and with the procedures and rules that help make diving safer—all done in a practical and immersive (literally) manner.
